LanguageData.RAF_Safety_rimexodus_seamlessworld: fixed by this mod: map sleep/wake follows synced player presence instead of each camera, maps generate synchronously, cross-map orders and map gizmos are synced, all players' pawns/homes are counted; trading with a settlement on its own map is disabled; settings locked in game - keep Sync configs on
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_ferny_perspectiveshift: drives a pawn from the keyboard inside the tick, without sync
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_memegoddess_replacestuff: over-rock blueprints, fog, cancel above bridges, bridge order and saving fixed by this mod; the 'Replace' stuff choice is synced
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_jellycreative_isekaileveling: gaps in Multiplayer Compatibility closed by this mod (auto-distribute, runes in the tick, drop zone, ranks, caches); settings locked in game - keep Sync configs on
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_mehni_pickupandhaul: settings (capacity, corpses, animals) affect job choice - turn on Sync configs and don't change them in game
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_m00nl1ght_mappreview: seed reroll and in-game preview disabled by this mod
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_co_uk_epicguru_meleeanimation: decorative mode: executions, duels, lasso and skills disabled by this mod
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_nals_facialanimation: component tick disabled, randomness isolated by this mod
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_fuu_bloodanimations: randomness isolated, no filth from animations
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_unlimitedhugs_allowtool: Multiplayer Compatibility; keep Sync configs on

LanguageData.RAF_Safety_TitleRisk: These mods may cause desyncs in multiplayer:
LanguageData.RAF_Safety_ClientBreak: The mod list contains mods incompatible with multiplayer (details in the log).

LanguageData.RAF_Evacuated: The settlement where your colonists were has closed - they left as a caravan.
LanguageData.RAF_SettingsMismatch: Mod settings differ between players (groups of players with identical settings):
LanguageData.RAF_ReplaceStuffSettingsLocked: Replace Stuff settings affect the simulation and are locked during a multiplayer game.
LanguageData.RAF_IsekaiSettingsLocked: Isekai RPG Leveling settings are locked during a multiplayer game: they affect the simulation and must be identical on every client. Change them from the main menu (all players must use the same values).
LanguageData.RAF_RimExodus_SettingsLocked: RimExodus settings are locked during a multiplayer game: the simulation reads them, so they must be identical on every client. Change them from the main menu (all players must use the same values).
LanguageData.RAF_RimExodus_SettlementTalkMp: Talking to a settlement trader on its own map is not available in multiplayer: the trade would happen on one computer only. Trade with a caravan from the world map.
LanguageData.RAF_RimExodus_MapViewed: Someone is looking at this map right now - it can't be put to sleep or removed.
LanguageData.RAF_RimExodus_MapNotYours: Another player has colonists or a home area on this map.
